# Simple Icons (platform logos)

The Meta, Steam, Google, Apple and HTC Vive logos in `streamer/assets/opendesk/platform-*.svg` are the glyphs from
[Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) 16.36.0 (CC0 1.0, see LICENSE.md), drawn in white on a square of the brand's
colour. The logos are trademarks of their owners; they are used only to show which platform an account belongs to.
Pico and Play for Dream have no Simple Icons entry and use plain letter badges.
